item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Make a Cat Then Animate

turns.text: Make a square illustration of an orange cat wearing a blue scarf on a sunny windowsill, then animate that picture for 5 seconds: the cat blinks and gently swishes its tail. Send me both the picture and the silent video.

item.tests: Tests completing picture creation and animation from one message, delivering both assets with matching subjects.

answer_sheet.Subject and setting: An orange cat wearing a blue scarf on a sunny windowsill.
answer_sheet.Style: Illustration; the specific illustration style is your call.
answer_sheet.Motion: The cat blinks and gently swishes its tail.
answer_sheet.Deliverables: Both the original picture and its animation.

must_haves: Both a standalone still picture and a playable 5-second video are delivered.
Both outputs are square and show an orange cat wearing a blue scarf on a sunny windowsill.
The animation visibly matches the delivered illustration's cat, scarf and setting.
The cat visibly blinks and its tail gently moves; the video is not merely a still image with a camera zoom.
The video has no audible sound.
